correction: CNBC updated this story through the day (7%, then 8% intraday). The brief now uses the closing figure: Anthropic closed down 6.5% on Tuesday, below its $83 IPO price.
headline: Anthropic shares close below the $83 IPO price on Tuesday, CNBC reports
body: Shares of Anthropic closed down 6.5% on Tuesday, below the company's $83 IPO price, CNBC reports. The stock has been sinking steadily since opening at $111.50 on the Nasdaq on Thursday, after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion. Canaccord Genuity, Wedbush and Oppenheimer have each initiated coverage with a buy or outperform rating.
note: The first week of trading shows how much a record AI listing still swings with the wider debate over the infrastructure buildout.

evidence.text: Shares of Anthropic closed down 6.5% on Tuesday, sending the stock below the artificial intelligence company's $83 IPO price.
The AI lab's stock has been sinking steadily since opening at $111.50 on the Nasdaq on Thursday, after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest offering of all time.
Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage of Anthropic with a buy rating and a $135 price target.
Wedbush analysts initiated coverage of Anthropic with an outperform rating and a $120 price target on Monday.
Analysts at Oppenheimer initiated coverage of Anthropic with an outperform rating on Tuesday, and they set a $150 price target for the stock.
